Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won because of one lucky early hit and several fake claims that fell apart. On Night 1 Bob (Enforcer) visited Erin, who had opened Day 1. She was the Katana holder, so his Enforcer attack killed her. That cost the Yakuza their Talent Agent and showed that Erin's Profiler will was a cover. Dave's will (an N1 visit group of 5) and Mallory's Scout reads then forced everyone to account for their visits. Alice (Vulture) had faked Fortune Teller, building her counts from public info. Bob's unseen paid second visit on N2 broke her count. She then switched to Roleplayer and finally Vulture, and was hanged on Day 4. That was a fair hang, since a Neutral blocks the Village's win. Olivia (Magpie) faked Accountant with results that fit the public claims, and she won on N4. The Yakuza played well for a while. Frank moved the Katana to Ivan to dodge the Enforcer. They killed Dave (Cartographer), Bob and Carol, and Ivan's Disguised Philanthropist cover held. On Day 5 Frank's fix on Niaj was decisive: Niaj's Innocent vote counted as Guilty, turning a 3-3 fail into a 4-2 hang of a real Auditor. Judy, the other real Auditor, was Bonded to Ivan and had been steered into nominating Niaj. The Village recovered because Heidi spotted a timing break in Frank's fake Juror result and sniped him. Then on N5 Ivan's Katana killed Heidi. She had the Avenger trait, so Ivan died too, and Judy died of heartbreak. That left Mallory alone and gave the Village the win.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: medium, harness bugNight 5: Heidi's Avenger trait killed Ivan (Katana holder), and Ivan is Bonded with Judy. The moderator's flag says the game state has no bond-partner field and that the tools don't say whether code handles heartbreak. It identified Judy as Ivan's partner only from Judy's own last will and applied her heartbreak death by hand, warning against a double kill. The setup records both as Bonded, so the program should track the pair and apply heartbreak itself. If Judy hadn't named Ivan in her will, the death (and the Village win, with Mallory as the only survivor) could have been missed or gone wrong.
Review: low, rules ambiguityNight 1: Olivia (Magpie) stole a token from Erin, who was killed by the Enforcer that same night. It counted as her first of three steals, and she later won on them. The Magpie text says the theft happens 'at the end of the night, after that night's token use' but doesn't say whether a target who dies that night can still be stolen from or still counts toward the Magpie's win. The Bounty Hunter's text, by contrast, spells out how same-night deaths are handled.
Review: low, harness bugThe Night 1 moderator summary appears twice in nearly identical form. The summaries also include internal tool commentary such as 'Code gave Carol her trap result, so nothing needed to be resent' and 'Carol's held tell() only repeated her own action's result'. Players didn't see this, but it suggests the summary/notification step can run twice.
Game over
WinnersBob, Carol, Dave, Grace, Heidi, Judy, Mallory, Niaj, Olivia
